mapper.select: SELECT USERNAME, PASSWORD, FULL_NAME, EMAIL, PHONE, STATUS, ROLE, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM TS_USER WHERE USERNAME = #{username}
SELECT USERNAME, FULL_NAME, EMAIL, PHONE, STATUS, ROLE, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM TS_USER ORDER BY USERNAME
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TS_USER ( USERNAME, PASSWORD, FULL_NAME, EMAIL, PHONE, STATUS, ROLE, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{user.username}, #{user.password}, #{user.fullName}, #{user.email}, #{user.phone}, #{user.status}, #{user.role}, #{user.createdBy}, #{user.creationDate}, #{user.lastUpdatedBy}, #{user.lastUpdateDate} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TS_USER SET FULL_NAME = #{user.fullName}, EMAIL = #{user.email}, PHONE = #{user.phone}, STATUS = #{user.status}, ROLE = #{user.role}, LAST_UPDATED_BY = #{user.lastUpdatedBy}, LAST_UPDATE_DATE = #{user.lastUpdateDate} WHERE USERNAME = #{user.username}
